data.gender_notes: Murari is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Murari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mur' meaning 'beloved'. This name is used to denote a devotee of Lord Vishnu or Rama. It is believed that Lord Rama was called Murari by his devotees, who were deeply devoted to him. The name Murari carries the meaning “Beloved of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Murari usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Murari belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murari total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
